name: Diamond Push-Up
steps: Start in a high plank with hands beneath your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to hold a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows back close to your ribs as you lower your chest toward your hands.
Press firmly through both palms until your arms straighten back into the plank.
tips: Keep your shoulders and hips moving together without letting your lower back sag.
Widen your hands slightly if pressing in a tight diamond causes wrist discomfort.
